top_signals.title: Zelenskyy Wins Serbian Pledges as Russian Influence Wanes
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a landmark first visit on Saturday to Serbia to expand cooperation with the Balkan country whose leader has been scaling back once-close ties with Russia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ukraine seeking air defense systems from South Korea
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also raised Kyiv's estimate of North Korean troops that could be sent to fight with Russia, saying up to 50,000 could be deployed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Verizon mobile service restored after outage for thousands of customers in the U.S.
top_signals.summary: Customers still having trouble with their service should restart their devices, the wireless carrier said. Verizon did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.

top_signals.title: Modal shift dampens trucking market
top_signals.summary:
Shippers appear to be using intermodal as pricing spreads near all-time highs, but there are risks to this looming later in the year.
